title: Deep learning on super-resolution images profiles epigenetic states
summary: A framework combining high-speed super-resolution microscopy with deep learning discriminated epigenetic states in HDAC-inhibited HEK293T cells (99.6% accuracy) and Rett syndrome iPS cells with MECP2 mutations (96.1%). It identified the nuclear periphery as a hotspot of H3K27ac and CTCF redistribution, and sequencing-based analyses showed compartment switching and lamina-associated domain changes consistent with the image features. Only two cell models were studied.
ai_technology: Deep learning classification of super-resolution nuclear images

evidence.tested: Image classification in two cell models, with orthogonal sequencing analyses as consistency checks.
evidence.unknown: Held-out design of the accuracy figures and generality beyond two models; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies nuclei by epigenetic state and localizes the features that discriminate them.
